capability_statement: Provider Pilot Execution Readiness: decide whether a provider-backed pilot can advance from one governed evidence chain.
before_state: Operators had to inspect separate provider records and infer readiness manually.
after_state: Operators can use the release contract and audits to see whether the full pre-execution chain is present and bounded.
scenario: Before starting a GitHub read-first provider pilot, an operator checks whether adapter, approval, target, reproduction, rollback, outcome, learning, incident, cost/quota, product value, and release-state evidence are connected.
five_minute_demo: Read docs/v10.9-release-definition.md, inspect CRD-TASK-130-V109, run release-state-audit, and confirm live provider execution remains not authorized.
time_saved_or_work_reduced: Reduces manual reconstruction of provider readiness from scattered artifacts.
cognitive_load_removed: Operators no longer have to remember every provider preflight artifact category before asking if the pilot can advance.

capability_matrix.user_value: operator can judge pilot readiness without mistaking it for live execution permission

not_proven: This value evidence does not prove external adoption, production safety, billing safety, or provider output correctness.
